name: Fatture in Cloud
description: Fatture in Cloud — the invoicing app of 580,000 Italian partite IVA: issued and received documents, clients, suppliers, products, receipts and the VAT-relevant e-invoice status. REST API v2, OAuth 2.0.
instructions:
**Getting a token**
1. Register an application in the **Fatture in Cloud developer console** (developers.fattureincloud.it). You receive a client id and client secret.
2. Run the authorization-code flow once for the account, requesting the scopes you need — `entity.clients:r`, `entity.suppliers:r`, `issued_documents:r`, `received_documents:r`, `products:r`, and the `:a` variants for write. Keep the **refresh token**.
3. Set `FIC_CLIENT_ID`, `FIC_CLIENT_SECRET`, `FIC_REFRESH_TOKEN` and `FIC_COMPANY_ID`. AnythingMCP refreshes the access token on its own.

**Every path carries a company id.** A Fatture in Cloud account can hold several companies (aziende) and each has its own numeric id; `FIC_COMPANY_ID` fixes this connector to one. `fatture_in_cloud_list_companies` is the exception — it is the one call that works without it, and it tells you which ids exist.

**Issued vs received.** `issued_documents` are the documents you send (invoices, quotes, credit notes, delivery notes); `received_documents` are supplier invoices you have recorded. The `type` parameter narrows within each: `invoice`, `quote`, `proforma`, `credit_note`, `order`, `receipt`, `delivery_note`.

**Fatturazione elettronica.** Italian e-invoices carry an `e_invoice` flag and an `ei_status` that tracks the document through the Sistema di Interscambio: `not_sent`, `sent`, `pending`, `accepted`, `rejected`. A rejected invoice is a real accounting problem and worth asking about by name.

**`fieldset=detailed`** returns the line items and payment schedule; the default returns headers only. Ask for detail when you need it and not before, because documents are large.

**Cloud reachability**: api-v2.fattureincloud.it is public with a valid certificate.

tools.name: fatture_in_cloud_list_companies
tools.description: List the companies (aziende) this account can reach, with their id, name and VAT number. The one call that works without a company id — use it to find the right FIC_COMPANY_ID.

tools.name: fatture_in_cloud_list_issued_documents
tools.description: List documents you issued — invoices, quotes, credit notes, proformas — with their number, date, client, total and payment status.

type.description: Document type: invoice, quote, proforma, receipt, delivery_note, credit_note, order, work_report, supplier_order, self_own_invoice, self_supplier_invoice.

fieldset.description: `basic` (default) or `detailed` to include line items and the payment schedule.

filter.description: Filter expression, e.g. date >= '2026-01-01' or entity.name = 'Rossi'.

sort.description: Sort field, prefix with `-` for descending, e.g. -date.

tools.name: fatture_in_cloud_get_issued_document
tools.description: Read one issued document in full: every line item with VAT rate, the payment schedule, the client's details and the e-invoice status in the Sistema di Interscambio.

tools.name: fatture_in_cloud_list_received_documents
tools.description: List supplier documents you have recorded — purchase invoices, credit notes and expenses — with their supplier, date, total and deductibility.

sort.description: Sort field, prefix with `-` for descending.

tools.name: fatture_in_cloud_list_clients
tools.description: List clients with their name, VAT number, codice fiscale, address and the e-invoice routing code (codice destinatario or PEC).

filter.description: Filter expression, e.g. name = 'Rossi' or vat_number = 'IT01234567890'.

sort.description: Sort field, prefix with `-` for descending.

tools.name: fatture_in_cloud_list_suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers with their name, VAT number, codice fiscale and address, for the purchasing side of the ledger.

tools.name: fatture_in_cloud_list_products
tools.description: List products and services from the catalogue with their code, description, net price, VAT rate and stock level.

tools.name: fatture_in_cloud_list_receipts
tools.description: List receipts (corrispettivi) with their date, amount and payment method — the till-side record, separate from invoices.

tools.name: fatture_in_cloud_get_company_info
tools.description: Read the configured company's own details: name, VAT number, tax regime, address and plan. Confirms FIC_COMPANY_ID points where you think it does.
